Asha (Partnerships): Heads-up — VendorX told us they'll remove the legacy `X-Vendor-Auth` header in ~60 days. They want partners migrated before the public announcement. We need an SDK compatibility plan + marketplace comms. Who can own the partner-facing timeline? :exclamation:
Tom L. (Eng): We can add a temporary fallback in SDK: check for `X-Vendor-Auth` and map to `Authorization: Bearer ...` for one release. Patch + canary for Dedicated customers first.
Priya (SDK): Proposed plan: 1) SDK patch that auto-maps header for two minor releases (flagged), 2) deprecate flag after 30d notice, 3) publish migration snippet + changelog. Sample fallback: `if (req.headers['x-vendor-auth']) { req.headers['authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + mapKey(req.headers['x-vendor-auth']) }`
Marcos (Marketplace): I'll draft the marketplace banner and partner advisory once we have dates. We usually want the banner up during the notice window and a banner removal 1 week after deprecation.
Ken (Legal): For joint-announcement language we need VendorX sign-off on copy; please drop draft to legal@redwood. Also confirm data-sharing language for telemetry.
Asha (Partnerships): Owner list? Priya = SDK owner, Tom = runtime + canary, Marcos = marketplace banner + partner comms, Ken = legal sign-off. I'll ping VendorX PM and ask for exact removal timestamp and migration samples. @Priya can you sketch the SDK flag name and default?
Priya (SDK): Flag: `--legacy-vendorx-auth` (default true for initial patch). Release plan: create v3.4.1 patch with flag on, v3.5.0 turn flag off (soft deprecation), then v4.0 remove fallback. Docs page + code snippet in migration guide.
Tom L. (Eng): For Dedicated we should run a small canary across 5 partner workspaces for 72h. If error rate spikes >0.5% revert. I'll add a canary job and an automated rollback window.
Asha (Partnerships): Vendor contact replied: they can give a 45-day removal window if we sign-off on a migration checklist. I'm going to propose 60 days with a 2-week canary + 30d public notice.
Marcos (Marketplace): Timeline check — marketplace publishing lead time is 7 business days for feature banners. If we want a banner during the notice window, we need final copy by EOD Friday.
Ken (Legal): I'll review draft language by Tue EOD, but need final VendorX agreement before we publish joint comms.
Priya (SDK): Quick Q: do we want telemetry on old header usage? I can add an opt-in telemetry event: `vendorx_legacy_header_detected` with counts per release. Need product OK.
Asha (Partnerships): Yes please — that will help measure cutover. Marcos, include that signal in the marketplace advisory so partners know to check our telemetry.
marketplace-bot: created event "VendorX legacy header deprecation — comms sync" on 2024-08-06 15:00 and invited Asha, Priya, Tom L., Marcos, Ken. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123
Tom L. (Eng): I'll prepare the canary job and add smoke tests to detect 401/403 regressions.
Marcos (Marketplace): I'll draft banner copy tonight and share tomorrow morning.
Asha (Partnerships): Action items recap: Priya — SDK patch + telemetry (owner). Tom — canary + smoke tests (owner). Marcos — marketplace banner + partner advisory copy (owner). Ken — legal review + VendorX agreement (owner). Asha — coordinate VendorX sign-off and schedule.
Priya (SDK): Got it. Will open PR with fallback + telemetry by EOD tomorrow.
Tom L. (Eng): I'll queue the canary and alerting.
Ken (Legal): Please add me to the PR for the advisory copy.
Marcos (Marketplace): Copy incoming.
Asha (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll post partner-facing timeline once VendorX confirms final timestamp. :thumbsup:
